nodes.label: Local Postgres 16 Service
nodes.rationale: postgres:16-alpine on :5432 with POSTGRES_INITDB_ARGS '--locale=C --encoding=UTF8' for DETERMINISTIC COLLATION — keeps ORDER BY identical to production. A pg_isready healthcheck exists because npm run db:migrate fails confusingly if it beats Postgres to ready. Named volume pravasi_pgdata persists data across restarts.

nodes.label: Adminer Schema Browser
nodes.rationale: Optional schema browser on :8080, gated on the postgres healthcheck via depends_on condition: service_healthy. Handy for eyeballing scan_logs during the gate tests.
